notes:
# v1.3.34 — detail page: no more sideways scroll, skeleton loading, single source row

- Fixed: on a phone the title detail page could be swiped left and right. An
  over-wide action bar (the auto-download toggle) pushed the page wider than the
  screen. The auto-download toggle has been removed from the detail page, and
  the detail view now clips horizontal overflow so the page can never pan
  sideways. The auto-download feature itself is unchanged and still works for
  titles that already have it enabled.
- New: the detail page's Information card (Source, Type, Status, Author, Artist,
  Chapters) and the About blurb now show shimmer skeleton placeholders while the
  source loads, instead of dashes and a "Loading description..." label.
- Fixed: the Sources list on the detail page no longer shows the same provider
  twice. Sources are collapsed to one row per provider.
